name: colorFabb LW-PLA, printed foamed (250 C, 45 % flow)
note: colorFabb LW-PLA data sheet (2023): Young's modulus 3350 MPa printed unfoamed at 200 C and 100 % flow, 860 MPa foamed at 250 C and 45 % flow (ISO 527-1A); unfoamed density 1.2 g/cm3. The foamed density is derived: 45 % of the plastic in the same volume, 0.54 g/cm3. Foaming depends on the printer, speed, and temperature; print and weigh a test strip to confirm.

source.title: colorFabb Light Weight PLA (LW-PLA) technical datasheet v1.0, 2023 (reseller copy)
